worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.summary: Lowers its head and drills straight ahead at full weight: a running full-body tackle that shoves the foe along and tears a short-lived furrow of raw earth out of the ground. The moment it commits the user's Defense and Sp. Def each drop one stage. The plowing form reaches farther, shoves harder and cuts a wider furrow at the cost of lower power and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.0: Charge in from range and knock a foe out of position
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.1: Trade body weight for one heaviest hit
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.use.2: Leave a furrow in the world that changes how others move
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.descripti: Smashes for %1$s physical damage and knocks the foe %2$s blocks along the impact line.
Charge range %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick; tears a %3$s-block-wide furrow along the path.
The guard is spent the moment it commits: the user's Defense drops %1$s stage(s) and Sp. Def drops %2$s, hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.plow.on: Plowing form: the furrow stays %1$s s, and the charge reaches farther and shoves harder.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.plow.off: Bracing form: stops dead on contact, heavier single hit and faster cast, but a shorter shove and furrow.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the churned soil to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.growth.1: From level %1$s the impact power rises to %2$s and the charge range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.headlongrush.preferenc: On: charge range x1.15, knock-back x1.2, furrow x1.3 and longer-lived; costs impact power x0.92, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off (bracing): stops dead on contact, heavier single hit and faster cast, but a shorter shove and furrow.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens from farther, but it is easier to sidestep mid-charge.
Only at least this far away will it prefer this move; up close there is no room to build momentum. Closer scores lower so other moves take over.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy single hit finishes them before the price is paid; off: all targets score the same.
Below this own health ratio the user holds Headlong Rush back (0 = no limit). Higher saves it for a worthwhile trade.
